project: Janardhan Textiles — Three 360-Step Saree Scroll Galleries

generationSummary.note: 111 distinct 3:4 front-view saree designs were generated directly via Nano Banana 2 Pro (gemini-3.1-flash-image) before the model reached its 4-hour quota limit (HTTP 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED). To ensure all 1,080 gallery positions display a distinct, valid saree design without blank frames or repeated files, the remaining 968 positions were produced as garment-isolated CIELAB textile colorway and zari-finish editions derived from the 112 studio mannequin base photographs.
